title: Rabbi Chanina bar Shalka
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Tanchuma, Ki Teitzei 10, and in Pesikta de-Rav Kahana 25b, where he, Rabbi Yehoshua of Sikhnin, and Rabbi Levi said [it] in the name of Rabbi Yochanan. In Eichah Rabbah ch. 5, 3 the reading is 'bar Shilka', and in Midrash Shmuel ch. 14, 9 'Rabbi Chanina bar Shelada'; Hyman favors the reading 'bar Shelaka'. The consulted Buber Tanchuma has bar Shalka. The consulted Midrash Shmuel prints Chanua bar Shalda with Chanina bar Shila as a bracketed alternative.

notes.text: Shalka, Shilka and Shalda are the notice’s different readings. Hyman prefers Shalka.
